summary: ConnectOne Bancorp, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 10, 2026, furnishing its September 2026 investor presentation as Exhibit 99.1 along with related XBRL exhibits. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural/regulatory terms are disclosed. The filing is an ordinary current report of corporate communications materials and does not constitute a special situation; no deal terms, ownership changes, or event-driven catalysts are present. No risk-arb angle applies.
